_about: Press conferences (Stage 6.3, src/sim/career/press.ts). One is called in a week when the next match is big (derby, top-of-the-table, playoff, final, a heated rivalry) or this week's result was notable. Questions come from src/data/press/questions.json. answerPressShare: the share of an answer's press effect that lands (Stage 7.3), so a run of calm answers cannot lift the press standing above where results put it.

triggers._about: bigMargin: goals for a big win or loss. upsetGap: table places between the clubs for an upset. lossRun / winRun: results in a row. top: both clubs in the top topPlaces (or the opponent leads and we are in the top topPlaces + 1) once topMinPlayed games are played. rivalHeat: heat with the next opponent that makes it a grudge match.

_order: Tags in the order their questions are asked; the first two found choose the conference's main questions.
_minGap: Weeks between league-stage conferences: one held this week means none next week unless the next match is a derby, a playoff or a final.

claim._about: A bold promise to win the next match. Kept (a win) or broken (a draw or a loss) when it has been played.

heat._about: Rivalry heat from answers is capped here; it cools in rivalry.json.
